segments.name: Banking platform
segments.description: Provides a banking platform for small businesses nationwide, earning mainly from net interest income and government guaranteed loans.
segments.evidence: Therefore, the Company has one significant operating segment as of December 31, 2024 and 2025, which is providing a banking platform for small businesses nationwide.

revenueModel.text: Revenue comes primarily from net interest income and secondarily from originating and selling government guaranteed loans to small businesses.
revenueModel.evidence: The banking platform generates revenue primarily from net interest income and secondarily through the origination and sale of government guaranteed loans.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company combined its Banking and Fintech reportable segments into one significant operating segment.
changes.evidence: Due to Canapi Advisors voluntarily withdrawing as an investment advisor to the Canapi Funds in the third quarter of 2024, the chief operating decision maker began evaluating the business on a consolidated basis.
